scope: Six existing research activities; does not schedule agents or grant permissions.
reading_rule: WORKFLOW governs scientific meaning. This is a machine-readable mirror for declared handoff completeness, not proof of science or consent.
general_rules: Stable activity responsibilities and evidence interfaces; scientific hypotheses, candidate algorithms, probes and experiments are not prescribed.
Scientific H1-H5 and H9/H10 user decisions, H6-H8 agent science decisions, activity evidence, and actual operation scope are separate; structural declarations do not authenticate access.
UNKNOWN/NOT_RUN/INVALID are legitimate findings and must be reported, not filled with fake results; they cannot satisfy a critical established-evidence prerequisite.
Reuse unchanged historical artifacts and user choices. Reopen only affected dependencies when provenance, truth, task, claim or protocol changes.

No automatic figures, new data downloads, SEALED access, manuscript writing, external transfer, paid/unsafe operations or submissions. Following actual H1-H5 project selection and safe verified DEV acceptance, in-scope local non-paid CPU/GPU fitting and code/dependency development are agent-autonomous with required science and provenance checks; explicit project holds override.
Activity 05 may run alongside activity 04 as soon as meaningful valid evidence exists, not only after final algorithm optimization.

The structural handoff flag alone never satisfies entry_requirements, user review, or original operation authorization. Distinguish declared entry evidence, declared H choices and actual permission source.
For theoretical/simulation Claim, do not fabricate empirical Run IDs; use the bounded NON_DATA claim evidence path with independent local verification references.

01.name: Scientific opportunity and evidence path
reopen_triggers: changed research scope or named nearest work
D1 or PROOF_PATH contradicts the scientific question

alternative_evidence_paths.EMPIRICAL: D1 official metadata, credible truth/independent units and predownload science fit
alternative_evidence_paths.NON_DATA: auditable PROOF_PATH, assumptions and resource/validation conditions

01.notes: H3 provisional question, H4 science resource choice, H5 final question; H4 is never download authorization.

02.name: Data acceptance and scientific observation
entry_requirements: H5 choice or valid inherited project decision
for empirical analysis: data access and accepted complete required files; unready projects may only prepare legally
reopen_triggers: invalid truth or insufficient independent groups

alternative_evidence_paths.EMPIRICAL: data manifest and legal DEV analysis; no SEALED distributions
alternative_evidence_paths.NON_DATA: assumptions, proof obligations, simulator/domain and independently checkable evidence

02.notes: DATA_ACQUIRED_VERIFIED means readable files only, not scientifically valid data; no reliable pattern is an acceptable honest finding.

03.name: Falsifiable primary Task
entry_requirements: compatible H5 scientific question and activity 02 scientific basis
H6 agent-owned scientific Task choice within user-selected H5 project; evidence and legal-input checks still mandatory
reopen_triggers: changed label timing, permitted K, input, metric, split or primary Task

alternative_evidence_paths.EMPIRICAL: verified data assumptions, group/evaluator and legal inputs
alternative_evidence_paths.NON_DATA: falsifiable theoretical or simulation proposition with auditable validation domain

03.notes: A literature-only task hypothesis before data acceptance is not a frozen empirical Task.

04.name: Method development and valid experiments
entry_requirements: H6 Task or recorded non-algorithm relevance decision

Local non-paid, safe CPU/GPU DEV fitting follows standing algorithm autonomy after H5 and verified data; check explicit project holds, resource/host limits and protected data. High-risk/paid/out-of-scope operations require independent consent.
reopen_triggers: major algorithm strategy or resource budget changed
new Task or evaluator and legal input changed

alternative_evidence_paths.EMPIRICAL: legal DEV Run, strong fair baseline, selection history and real cost
alternative_evidence_paths.NON_DATA: mathematical, simulation or measurement mechanism and audit references

04.notes: H7 agent-owned major algorithm mechanism/scientific strategy decision; routine and major in-scope DEV experiments need no user reconfirmation. Justified non-method Claim can declare H7 NOT_APPLICABLE. Scientific and safety/provenance checks remain mandatory.

applicability_contract.NOT_APPLICABLE: Requires not_applicable_reason and not_applicable_evidence_ref; declares scope exclusion, not research success or H7 approval.
applicability_contract.H7_CONDITIONAL: H7 is an agent-owned evidence-backed decision checkpoint for major algorithm/strategy changes, not a user permission. A justified non-method Claim can declare NOT_APPLICABLE.

05.name: Scientific contribution and reinvestment review
entry_requirements: meaningful credible positive or negative evidence; may run before activity 04 has ended
reopen_triggers: new reliable evidence alters main Claim or nearest-neighbor gap
major additional investment, pivot or project stop

alternative_evidence_paths.EMPIRICAL: real DEV and group-level Run evidence with limits and negatives
alternative_evidence_paths.NON_DATA: valid proof, mechanism or critical synthesis evidence and counterexamples

05.notes: H8 agent-owned DEV Claim, narrowing, next-science-investment and branch HOLD decisions within approved H5 scope; project-level STOP/pivot outside H5 or formal independent claims still need user decision or independent evidence.

06.name: Independent confirmation and research closeout
entry_requirements: H9 protocol choice when confirmatory path applicable; separate actual resource access authorization
reopen_triggers: selection contamination, confirmation failure or permission revoked

alternative_evidence_paths.EMPIRICAL: single frozen independent assessment or honest unavailability with limited scope
alternative_evidence_paths.NON_DATA: independent auditable proof/validation or explicitly recorded missing confirmation

06.notes: H9 is conditional on eligible formal confirmation; H10 science summary never bypasses the separate manuscript writing permission gate.

applicability_contract.H9_CONDITIONAL: H9 needed for independent confirmation; absence of valid independent resources must be documented as CONFIRMATION_UNAVAILABLE, not a confirmation success.
applicability_contract.H10: H10 scientific review remains required for closeout; does not authorize writing.
